# Leak Detection Bargersville

> Non-invasive leak detection for homes in Bargersville, Indiana and across Johnson County. We find hidden water leaks with acoustic listening, thermal imaging and pressure testing, mark the exact spot, and provide a photo report for plumbers and insurers.

- Location: Bargersville, IN 46106 (service-area business)
- Service area: Bargersville, Greenwood, Franklin, Center Grove, Whiteland, New Whiteland, Trafalgar
- Hours: Open 24/7 for emergencies
- Email: adeelnaqshbandi@gmail.com

## Services
- [Slab Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/slab-leak-detection/): leaks in water lines under concrete foundations
- [Water Line Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/water-line-leak-detection/): breaks between the meter and the house
- [Pool & Spa Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/pool-leak-detection/): shell, fittings and plumbing lines
- [Thermal Imaging Inspection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/thermal-imaging/): hidden moisture behind walls, ceilings and floors
- [Shower & Wall Leaks](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/shower-wall-leak-detection/): shower pans, valves and drains
- [Irrigation Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/irrigation-leak-detection/): sprinkler lines, heads and valves
